lines.text: Clawd gave me a hundred dollars of credit, so I spent a few days in the new Projects.
A project has one main chat. It plans the work and hands each piece to its own thread.
The part I liked most: one click on pick up recent work. It read my last fourteen sessions and came back with three threads, ready to start.
Each thread is its own session. If you've used subagents or Cowork, it's the same idea, with a cleaner window around it.
Over a few days it built a KPI cockpit prototype, a hand-drawn video engine, an AI presentation, and a quoting tool.
The one that stuck was for my wife. The Curry Studio now gets a quote, an invoice and a client email from one message.
It's the smoothest Clawd has felt. For a small business, this is the tool. For my own work, I'm staying in Clawd Code.

notes: Spoken text spells Claude as 'Clawd' (pronounced klawd, like 'clawed'). On-screen text keeps 'Claude'. Model: eleven_v4.
